title: BONOBO transcription factors positively regulate STICKY GENERATIVE CELL for generative cell internalisation in Arabidopsis.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥BONOBO转录因子对SGC的正向调控及生殖细胞内化过程，涉及TF-DNA调控但无结合位点预测或互作建模，方法为转基因表达分析，非AI/物理模拟，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Generative cell internalisation establishes distinctive 'cell-within-a-cell' pollen organization in angiosperms. Comparative and transgenic expression analyses provide valuable insights into the cytological and genetic regulation underlying generative cell internalisation in Arabidopsis. For double fertilisation in flowering plants, a three-celled male gametophyte (pollen grain) delivers two non-motile sperm cells to the female gametes through a rapidly elongating pollen tube. This process is facilitated by a distinctive'cell-within-a-cell' pollen organisation, where the smaller generative cell becomes internalised into the larger vegetative cytoplasm through precisely regulated morphogenetic process and callose dynamics. However, the genetic mechanisms underlying generative cell internalisation remain unclear. Therefore, this study aims to comparatively analyse Arabidopsis wild-type with two different mutants that exhibit immobilised generative cells from the loss-of-function of DUF707 STICKY GENERATIVE CELL (SGC) and bHLH transcription factors BONOBO (BNB1) and BNB2, respectively. The results show that wild-type generative cells internalise through four successive steps. In contrast, bnb1;bnb2 mutants fail to progress to step 3 due to incomplete dissolution of the hemispherical callose and sgc-1 mutant proceeds to step 3 but arrests before step 4 with the intine-side callose dissolution disturbed. Moreover, transgenic analyses employing SGC promoter reporters and various BNB expression constructs revealed that SGC expression is positively regulated by BNB transcription factors. These findings enhance the understanding of the cytological and genetic regulation involving BNB transcription factors and downstream components, including SGC, during generative cell internalisation.
abstract_zh: 生殖细胞的内化在被子植物中建立了独特的“细胞中的细胞”花粉组织结构。比较和转基因表达分析为拟南芥中生殖细胞内化背后的细胞学和遗传调控提供了宝贵的见解。对于开花植物的双受精，一个三细胞雄性配子体（花粉粒）通过快速伸长的花粉管将两个非运动精子细胞递送至雌配子。这一过程得益于一种独特的“细胞中的细胞”花粉组织，其中较小的生殖细胞通过精确调控的形态发生过程和胼胝质动态被内化到较大的营养细胞质中。然而，生殖细胞内化背后的遗传机制仍不清楚。因此，本研究旨在比较分析拟南芥野生型与两种不同突变体，这些突变体分别因DUF707 STICKY GENERATIVE CELL (SGC)和bHLH转录因子BONOBO (BNB1)及BNB2的功能丧失而表现出固定不动的生殖细胞。结果表明，野生型生殖细胞通过四个连续步骤内化。相比之下，bnb1;bnb2突变体因半球形胼胝质不完全溶解而无法进展至步骤3，而sgc-1突变体进展至步骤3但在步骤4前停滞，其内壁侧胼胝质溶解受到干扰。此外，使用SGC启动子报告基因和多种BNB表达构建体的转基因分析揭示，SGC表达受BNB转录因子的正向调控。这些发现增进了对生殖细胞内化过程中涉及BNB转录因子及下游组分（包括SGC）的细胞学和遗传调控的理解。
